t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The game is random, do not pay attention to colour or shape of the Gnomes as this has no bearing on how many mushrooms you will receive. Also make sure that you pay attention to the timeframes and do not miss out on key presses and by extension, mushrooms/points. Take advantage of the breaks to refresh/rest your eyes to ensure you pay full attention.

vb_textbox.text: Allegedly the colour and shape of the Gnomes make no difference to how many mushrooms are collected, however I found that Yellow gives 0 mushrooms more often than any other colour. On a x5, I also found that Green, or Blue often gave 35 or 40 mushrooms more than the others. Take full advantage of the breaks as you do not want to miss a button press.
